topic.name: [Course] - Microsoft Power BI para Business Intelligence e Data Science

questions.question_text: Which Power BI product is free and used to build reports on a local computer?
questions.explanation: Power BI Desktop is the free tool for building dashboards on your own machine. Its limit is that reports stay local, so sharing them online requires Pro or Premium.

questions.question_text: In Power Query, what does each applied transformation step correspond to in the underlying code?
questions.explanation: Each step you apply in Power Query is recorded as an M instruction. You can open the Advanced Editor to read or customize that code.

questions.question_text: A dashboard must show how many sales occurred in each product category. Which visual fits best?
questions.explanation: Counts across categories are a comparison, which a bar chart shows clearly. A card shows one number, a map needs geographic data, and a waterfall shows how parts add up to a total.

questions.question_text: Two tables have a many-to-many relationship. What is the recommended approach in Power BI?

options.B: Add a bridge (intermediate) table that links them through one-to-many relationships
options.C: Merge both tables into one column

questions.explanation: Many-to-many relationships cause integrity problems and slower queries. A bridge table turns them into one-to-many relationships, which keeps filters predictable.

questions.question_text: A KPI has a monthly target of 350 for average sale value. What does the target represent?

options.B: The goal the business aims to reach each month
options.C: The number of sales lines in the month

questions.explanation: A target is the goal a KPI is compared against. Attainment is actual divided by target, so a value of 280 against 350 means 80% attainment.

questions.question_text: Total profit is 3,160 and total sales is 3,490. Monthly margins are 87.29%, 91.00%, and 91.43%, which average 89.91%. Which margin should a KPI card show as the business margin?

options.A: 89.91%, the average of the monthly margins
options.C: 90.54%, total profit divided by total sales

questions.explanation: Margin is total profit divided by total sales. Averaging monthly percentages gives every month the same weight regardless of its size, so the result can differ from the true ratio.

questions.question_text: Two tables should be linked on a CustomerID column, but Power BI does not create the relationship automatically. What is the most useful first check?

options.A: Confirm that CustomerID has no duplicates on the "one" side and matches exactly in both tables
options.D: Publish the report to Power BI Mobile

questions.explanation: Power BI only creates a relationship when the keys are consistent. Duplicates on the "one" side, or extra spaces and mismatched values, block detection. Counting values by group reveals duplicates quickly.

questions.question_text: A monthly KPI has a target of 350, and this month's average sale value is 280. What is the best way to present it to a manager?

options.D: The 280, with 80% attainment and a "below target" status

questions.explanation: A KPI is most useful when it shows the actual value, the target, the attainment percentage (280 ÷ 350 = 80%), and a clear status. A single number without the target hides whether the result is good.

questions.question_text: A page had 1,200 visitors and 96 purchases. What is the conversion rate?
questions.explanation: Conversion rate is the share of visitors who complete the desired action: 96 ÷ 1,200 = 8%.

questions.question_text: A numeric column was loaded as text and contains "?" values. Power Query's quality summary counts them as valid. Why?

options.A: Because the column is typed as text, so "?" counts as valid text
options.D: Because the quality summary ignores text

questions.explanation: Quality checks evaluate values against the column's type. A numeric column typed as text accepts "?", so the type should be set to a number and non-numeric values handled explicitly.

questions.question_text: The margin by Category does not add up to the total margin on the dashboard. Which change fixes the cause in the model rather than in the visuals?

options.C: Define margin as a measure, DIVIDE(total profit, total sales), so it recalculates for each filter context
options.D: Convert the margin to a text column

questions.explanation: Averaging row-level or category-level percentages breaks at other filter levels. Build the base sums as measures, then derive the ratio with DIVIDE so it is correct for any selection.

questions.question_text: A team sets prices using a "profit" equal to sales minus shipping cost, which gives margins near 90%. What is the most systemic problem?

options.A: The display precision is too low
options.C: Shipping cost should be added to sales
options.D: The profit definition ignores product cost, so margins overstate real profitability

questions.explanation: Sales minus shipping leaves out the cost of the goods sold, so it is not a gross margin. Pricing decisions need the full cost definition, checked against accounting.

questions.question_text: Monthly averages of sale value are 500 in March (3 lines) and 280 in April (5 lines), against a target of 350. A manager wants to know whether the trend is real. What is the most defensible answer?

options.A: Averages from so few lines are unstable, so no trend conclusion should be drawn yet
options.B: The trend is real, since March is 143% of target
options.C: Always use the median instead of the average

questions.explanation: With only 3 to 5 lines per month, one order can move the average sharply. Check the sample size for each period before reading a trend.

questions.question_text: A monthly total breaks after a refresh on a computer with a different regional setting, because dates load as text. Which fix addresses the cause?

options.B: Convert the date column to a Date type using the correct locale during transformation, and validate it on load
options.D: Replace the chart with a card

questions.explanation: Date formats depend on regional settings: 03/04 is March 4 in one locale and April 3 in another. Typing the column explicitly with the correct locale fixes parsing at the source.

questions.question_text: A many-to-many relationship between Sales and Shipping double-counts sales in totals. What is the systemic remedy?

options.A: Use DISTINCTCOUNT on the sales amount
options.D: Add an intermediate table so each link is one-to-many and each sale is aggregated once

questions.explanation: A many-to-many join repeats rows on both sides, so sums are inflated. A bridge table restores one-to-many links, and each sale is then counted once.

questions.question_text: You are planning a three-year Power BI roadmap covering sales, shipping, and forecasting. Which sequencing minimizes risk?

options.B: Governed data model and metric definitions first, then descriptive KPIs, then segmentation and forecasting
options.C: Machine learning first, since models refresh automatically

questions.explanation: Forecasts and segments inherit the quality of the data model and the metric definitions. Stabilizing those first avoids rework and conflicting numbers later.

questions.question_text: A board proposes cutting prices because a margin of about 90% looks healthy, and that margin excludes product cost. What is the most critical response?

options.A: Approve, since the dashboard shows a healthy margin
options.B: Hide the margins from the board
options.C: Reject the basis for the decision, define a gross margin that includes product cost, and reconcile it with accounting
options.D: Collect a larger sample before deciding

questions.explanation: A metric that ignores a major cost is a simplification, not a business result. Critical review means checking the definition before acting on the number.

questions.question_text: Monthly KPI averages rest on 2, 3, and 5 lines. Which long-term governance decision is strongest?

options.A: Require a minimum sample size or a rolling window before judging target attainment, and show the line count next to the KPI
options.C: Keep the monthly averages as they are

questions.explanation: Governance should define when a KPI is reliable. Setting a minimum volume or rolling window, and showing the count beside the metric, lets readers judge its strength.

questions.question_text: You want to add anomaly detection to a sales dashboard. Which staged approach is most sound?

options.B: Limit anomaly detection to marketing data
options.C: Skip simple rules and go straight to a model
options.D: Start with statistical baselines such as the IQR rule or z-score, document the threshold assumption, and adopt a learned model only if it beats those baselines on labeled cases

questions.explanation: Simple rules are transparent and cheap, and they set the bar any model must clear. The threshold or contamination assumption controls how many points get flagged, so it must be documented.

questions.question_text: Over five years, a company wants Power BI for reporting only, with no warehouse and no star schema. What is the strongest argument against that?

options.A: Star schemas are unnecessary for reporting
options.B: Excel is enough for any amount of data
options.C: As sources and users grow, a governed star schema keeps metrics consistent and reduces rework, at the cost of upfront modeling

questions.explanation: A star schema separates measures from descriptive dimensions, which keeps queries fast and definitions shared. The upfront modeling cost is repaid as the number of reports and sources grows.
